title: landing-page-react-vite template UI manifest
description: Declares where UI building blocks live in scenarios generated from the landing-page-react-vite template. Consumed by react-component-library's adoption resolver to compute canonical filesystem paths for adopted components. This template organizes routed UI under feature surfaces (public-landing, admin-portal) rather than a flat pages/ directory.

contract.extensionRule: Scenarios may override individual slot `dir` values inside their own .vrooli/ui-manifest.json overlay. New slot names must be added to the template manifest, not the overlay.

ui-primitive.description: Headless primitives (button, input, card) shared across surfaces. Kebab-case filenames.

shared-component.description: Cross-cutting components used by multiple surfaces (e.g. ErrorBoundary, RuntimeSignalStrip).

layout-shell.description: App shell and route composition (App, providers). Owns the router and top-level layout.

page.description: Routed pages within a feature surface (public-landing, admin-portal).

feature.description: Feature surface folder. Owns its own routes, sections, and components.

feature-component.description: A single component inside a feature surface folder.

api-client.description: Connect-RPC client modules and small API wrappers.
